description: Gammon Pakistan Limited was incorporated on 12 August 1947 as a public company limited by shares, and its shares are quoted on the Pakistan Stock Exchange. It is principally engaged in the execution of civil construction works, specialising in concrete and structural works. The company has taken part in Indus Basin projects as part of a consortium, including the Mailsi Siphon project and an aggregate supply contract, and lists Gammon Pakistan Pre-Cast Limited, The General Tyre & Rubber Company and other Bibojee Group companies among its associates.
